name: Deploy Call Kent Audio Worker

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'packages/audio-worker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-call-kent-audio-worker.yml'

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x]
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        cache: 'npm'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cd packages/audio-worker
        npm ci
        
    - name: Build package
      run: |
        cd packages/audio-worker
        npm run build
        
    - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Workers
      uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
      with:
        apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        workingDirectory: packages/audio-worker
        command: deploy
        env: production
        
    - name: Deploy Container to Cloudflare
      uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
      with:
        apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        workingDirectory: packages/audio-worker
        command: deploy --env container
        env: container
        
    - name: Update Queue Configuration
      run: |
        curl -X PATCH "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}/queues/call-kent-audio-processing" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d '{
            "name": "call-kent-audio-processing",
            "delivery_delay": 0,
            "max_retries": 3,
            "dead_letter_queue": {
              "destination": "call-kent-audio-dlq"
            }
          }'
          
    - name: Validate Deployment
      run: |
        echo "Deployment completed successfully"
        echo "Worker URL: https://audio-worker.kentcdodds.workers.dev"
        echo "Container endpoint: https://audio-worker-container.kentcdodds.workers.dev"
